subject: Conference Announcement: 37th Molecular Modelling Workshop in Erlangen, Germany - March 31 - April 2

messages.author: Dr. Anselm Horn
messages.body:
Dear all,
on behalf of the organizing committee I'm happy to share with you the
following conference announcement.
Best regards,
Anselm Horn

-----------------------------------------------------------------
Dear colleagues,
(apologies for cross-posting).
We wanted to bring the *Molecular Modeling Workshop 2025* (MMWS 2025,
March 31 � April 2 in Erlangen, Germany) to your attention. The goal of
the workshop is to provide *young scientists* with a platform to present
their research, exchange ideas with peers, and connect with others in
the field. Additionally, the workshop offers a valuable networking
opportunity, both within academia and with industry representatives.
The thematic focus of MMWS 2025 is "Bridging Molecular Modelling between
Ground- and Excited States," and we are excited to have Jan Meisner,
Christoph Bannwarth, Reinhard Maurer, and Renana Gershoni Poranne as
plenary speakers covering this topic from various angles.
This workshop is a great opportunity for PhD candidates and PostDocs to
present their work and receive valuable feedback.
We have extended the submission deadline to February 28, 2025, so there
is still plenty of time to submit an abstract.
You can find all details regarding abstract submission and registration
here: https://mmws2025.mgms-ds.de/.
Looking forward to seeing you in Erlangen,
Carolin M�ller and Petra Imhof
